items.text: You are a Dummy Corporation trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
Welcome, trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
Shenzhen Smart City, tile by tile. Each tile trains you to its brief.

items.text: Neon shops, LED walls; one road splits round the monument under the walkway ring. Your training begins here.

items.text: Water and concrete; a boulevard passes under the raised ring. Your write-offs open the Expo to clients.

items.text: A hill walled by towers; bridges cross the drive and the river. Certified dummies ship across it to clients.
Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.
The welcome wall shows your face and the word WELCOME. Stand in the road until a colleague notices you.
Battery 1 is fitted. Staff watch from the podium bridge; you join the road and dash into a colleague.
The drum warns every colleague of each bend. Step off the high road onto a car; gravity is company policy.
The raised road runs through this tower. Take the final hit up there, and Certification comes closer.
The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS, a target. Walk or stand beside it until a colleague finds you.
The neon shops flash prices at the traffic. Hands 1 is fitted: place a cone, and let a colleague react.
Each cube rests on the one before. Chain your hits the same way; the last link writes you off.
Legs 1 is fitted. The screens advertise to each other; jump into a car between them.
Under the gateway, your file reads ROLE: DESTRUCTIVE TESTING. Let one colleague throw you into the next.
The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.
The lantern is lit for the Expo's clients. Arms 1 is fitted: push off one car into the next.
On opening day, our board will watch from these terraces. A van delivers the catering; let it deliver you.
The arch is the Expo's gate. Clients enter when the park passes; chain each hit to the last.
On opening day, police escort a school party to the obelisk. Take a police car's hit first.
A wedding is booked on the belvedere. Legs 2 is fitted: jump into a car, so no guest does.
The dome awaits clients. Hands 2 is fitted: lay a cone, and let the car that reacts write you off.
Arms 2 is fitted. Teach the cars to stop before the reservoir: push off one, into the next.
The cascade steps down beside the highway. Climb to the raised road; a write-off there serves our clients.
Battery 2 is fitted. The board watches the ring; end a long chain on a car for our clients.
Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared.
At the west portal, buses carry engineers to the bridge. We need the bus fleet's data; meet the bus.
Legs 3 is fitted: the longest flight. Jump at a car by the tunnel portal; your data serves our clients.
The police check papers at the east portal. Take your final hit from a police car; your papers follow.
Beyond the rail, ships wait to carry Certified dummies to clients. Drop onto a car below.
The customs post logs every dummy shipped to our clients. Be thrown into a car, and earn your entry.
Show Chassis 0 how far the model has come. Arms 3 is fitted: push off one car into the next.
Your customs entry reads DECLARED VALUE ONE UNIT · PURPOSE DESTRUCTION. Honour the declaration on the raised road.
Sand on the west beach terrace came from three provinces. Place a cone; the car that reacts writes you off.
The monument is cast from every write-off. Battery 3 is fitted: finish the chain and ship Certified.
Your model has passed and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.
